long.text: Learn enough about how lidar reveals buried structures to tell a real find from a wishful one, and eventually write a short page I would stand behind.
long.reason: The lidar finds keep pulling at me, and a day of skimming will not be enough to understand them.

steps.reason: Read the sites themselves, what was found and how it was dated, before touching the sensor again.
Put down in my own words what a site looks like on the ground, not what the lidar says about it.
Let the writing settle before I go back to any terrain model.
The doors are still unfinished, and the house has been neglected while I looped.
A long rest at home once the reading, the writing and the tending are done.

today.reason: The canopy loop repeated with nothing new, so I am dropping the canopy writing and reading the Maya sites from the ground, then writing about them, with the house and a long rest after.
